(4) In an editorial on October 18, _The Arkansas Democrat-Gazette_ wrote, after a lengthy review of President Trump's accomplishments, "A vote for Trump instead of Biden might be the best check on that [a Democratic controlled Congress] becoming a reality in America." Although the editorial does not use the word "endorsement," The American Presidency Project judges this to be an editorial endorsement of Donald Trump.
(5) This newspaper is owned by _The McClatchy Company_.
In an internal memo, the company directed their 30 newspapers to only issue an endorsement for president in instances in which the newspaper's editorial board interviewed the candidates.
The American Presidency Project will continue to monitor these papers for an endorsement, although it is unlikely these papers will endorse.
See: "McClatchy’s 30 newspapers probably won’t be endorsing this year." New York Times, September 17, 2020.
